name: Linger MCP
description: Browse saved design references, existing image previews, and Project Canvases through a local stdio server bundled with the Linger desktop app. Requires an initialized Linger library on an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later. Read-only by default. An explicit --allow-write flag enables machine analysis, vocabulary suggestions, and job queue actions.
license: Proprietary (bundled with the Linger desktop app)
